records.title: AECID Spanish Government Scholarship
records.official_source: Agencia Española de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AECID)
records.application_period: Convocatoria 2026/2027; each sub-programme opens and closes on its own dates (2026 sub-programmes closed between April and July 2026)

records.title: UniTrento Scholarships for International Students (non-EU candidates residing abroad)
records.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship call: scholarships are assigned through each degree programme's admission ranking, so the deadline is that programme's admission application deadline. The University of Trento's 2026/2027 admission calls for non-European candidates closed in March 2026, and the 2027/2028 calls had not been published on 4 October 2026.
records.application_period: Tied to each degree programme's annual admission call for non-European candidates residing abroad. For the 2026/2027 cycle published deadlines included 4 March 2026 at 12:00 CET on several English-taught master's programmes and 23 March 2026 on others, each with a EUR 30.00 application fee.

records.title: NL Scholarship (University of Groningen)
records.deadline_display: "The deadline for the 2026-2027 academic year is 1 February 2026 (23:59 CET)." The page had not been updated with a 2027-2028 deadline when checked on 2026-10-04.
records.application_period: Annual cycle tied to the master's admission round; applications open after the applicant receives an admission offer, with a 1 February deadline for the 2026-2027 academic year and results notified by 15 March.

records.title: KAIST Scholarship (KAIST International Graduate Admission)
records.official_source: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Office of Admissions
records.deadline_display: KAIST International Graduate Admission general windows: Spring Admission: Mid August - Early September; Fall Admission (Early Track): Early December - Late December; Fall Admission (Regular Track): Early March - Late March. Published 2027-entry dates: Spring 2027 Entry: August 18 - September 1, 2026; Fall 2027 Entry: TBA.
records.application_period: The 2027 Spring Semester international-track window (2026/08/18 - 2026/09/01) has closed. The next published window is Fall Admission (Early Track), Early December - Late December; the Fall 2027 Entry dates are published as TBA on the official timeline page.

records.title: KAIST Prestige Scholarship for International Ph.D. Students (KPS)
records.official_source: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
records.deadline_display: No separate scholarship deadline - KPS follows KAIST International Graduate Admission periods, listed officially as 'Spring/Fall Early/Fall Regular'. For 2027 entries KAIST publishes 'Spring 2027 Entry: August 18 - September 1, 2026' and 'Fall 2027 Entry: TBA'.
records.application_period: Three annual admission periods (Spring, Fall Early, Fall Regular). Spring 2027 entry applications ran 18 Aug - 1 Sep 2026; Fall 2027 entry dates are still listed as TBA.

records.title: Ireland Fellows Programme
records.official_source: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Irish Aid), Government of Ireland
records.deadline_display: "Applications for the 2027/28 academic year are now closed." The next cycle follows a recurring three-stage annual process: Stage 1 preliminary applications approximately June/July, Stage 2 detailed applications approximately mid-September to mid-October, Stage 3 interviews approximately November/December.
records.application_period: Annual cycle: Stage 1 preliminary application approximately June/July, Stage 2 detailed application approximately mid-September to mid-October, Stage 3 interviews approximately November/December.

records.title: Eric Bleumink Fellowship
records.deadline_display: There is no scholarship application deadline: "It is not possible to actively apply for an Eric Bleumink Fellowship Scholarship. Suitable candidates will be informed about a nomination." Applicants must hold a provisional or unconditional admission offer for a master programme received before February, and their master's application "should be completed by the applicant before 1st of December".
records.application_period: Annual cycle tied to master's admission for a September start; master's applications to be completed before 1 December and admission offers received before February

records.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
records.deadline_display: Each partner in the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program sets their own deadline. Please check the Program website of the partner institution(s) of your choice for the specific deadline.
records.application_period: No central application window. The programme is published as active and ongoing from August 2012, and applications are accepted on each partner institution's own admissions schedule.
